blocks.text: I wanted to open a thread to keep us current on the reputation audit for {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}}, so the updates and any questions stay in one place as we go. We are a few weeks in now and moving on two fronts at once, and so far the picture is taking shape roughly as we expected.

Kimberly Le has finished the first pass through the recent coverage and the analyst notes, and she is now sorting what she found into the themes that come up most often. Alongside that, we are ready to begin the confidential interviews, and I have a short list of the internal people we would like to speak with. Where any of them sit outside your own group, a quick word from you to clear the introduction would help us reach them.

The one thing we need from your side to hold this pace is the last set of investor materials, meaning the most recent deck and any messaging you have used since the fall. I will keep these requests coming to you directly, Robert Smith, rather than spread across the Gallegos, Pope and Marsh team, so nothing gets lost between desks. Send them whenever they are to hand and we will take the next step from there.
